decisions.reason: The handle family sits close to the core range and is still listed after the 2019 cull of weaker siblings, so it seems to be meeting aspirations, and the firm's slack lets it stay in a broad catalogue at low cost.

This door handle design survived the 2019 portfolio pruning, which suggests acceptable results, but handle designs are refreshed regularly, so there is a moderate risk it is phased out as the range is renewed.

The electronic access system with its unique light technology fits the firm's strategic move toward digital building organization and was further developed into the Pro version, so management will keep supporting it even if early results are uncertain.
